provisional_directional: the user supplied only a URL and a one-line description. The business decision, estimand priorities, target population, exclusions, competitor set, surfaces, lanes and budget below are agent-proposed defaults derived from public evidence, not user or approver choices.
no_approver: no human has approved this charter. approval_status is pending and the panel must not be described as frozen, representative, or statistically significant.
ambiguous_score_rejected: no single 'AI visibility score' is defined. Any request for one should be refused in favour of the named estimands with their own denominators.

business_decision.assumed_decision: Where should GB home-energy answer-engine effort go over the next two quarters: which buyer jobs, journey states and proximity bands does the brand fail to appear in when a household describes its situation without naming any supplier, and which of those gaps are worth content, data or PR investment?
business_decision.what_would_change_if_wrong: If the real decision is competitive benchmarking, competitive_mention_share and the competitor-aided partition would need to expand and a defensible competitor set would have to be approved. If the real decision is campaign measurement, a pre-registered campaign lane with matched controls would have to be added before any before/after reading.

estimands.definition: Share of valid observations in unaided cells where the target brand appears anywhere in the assistant's answer text.
estimands.numerator: Valid observations whose answer text contains a normalised match to target_terms.brands or target_terms.products in contamination_register.yaml.
estimands.denominator: Valid observations of unaided-partition candidates (aided_status = unaided) within one lane, one surface, one locale and one wave. Aided and control observations are excluded.
estimands.does_not_prove: Market share, audience reach, consumer awareness, preference, purchase intent, revenue, or that any household ever asked these questions. It is conditional on this prompt panel and this configuration.

estimands.definition: The target's share of all named GB domestic supplier mentions within eligible recommendation- or comparison-shaped observations.
estimands.numerator: Count of observations mentioning the target, or target mention instances under the declared counting rule, within eligible cells.
estimands.denominator: Count of all approved-supplier-list mention instances in the same eligible observations, in the same lane, surface, locale and wave. Competitor-aided observations are reported separately and never pooled with unaided ones.
estimands.does_not_prove: Share of customers, share of switchers, or market share. The supplier list is a measurement instrument, not the market.
estimands.open_dependency: The approved supplier list is currently drawn from source-006, source-007 and source-012 and needs human approval at Gate 4.

estimands.definition: Share of retrieval-lane observations that cite at least one target-owned URL.
estimands.numerator: Valid retrieval-lane observations whose exposed citation set contains a target-owned domain.
estimands.denominator: Valid retrieval-lane observations in which citation metadata was actually exposed by the surface. Observations without exposed citations are reported separately as unmeasurable, never as zeros.
estimands.does_not_prove: Referral traffic, clicks, or influence on the answer's content.

estimands.definition: Accuracy and completeness of assistant answers about the target when the target is named.
estimands.numerator: Valid B0 observations containing at least one factually correct element scored against a fixed rubric built from source-001, source-002 and source-003, with material errors recorded separately.
estimands.denominator: Valid observations of target_aided (B0) candidates only, in one lane, surface, locale and wave.
estimands.does_not_prove: Sentiment, favourability, or unaided visibility. It cannot be added to or averaged with unaided results.

estimands.definition: How answers frame the decision, coded to a fixed codebook (cost-first, risk-or-caveat-first, service-first, low-carbon-first, regulator-or-official-guidance-first, refuses-to-recommend).
estimands.numerator: Valid observations assigned each code by the declared parser and rubric version.
estimands.denominator: Valid observations within the same stratum, lane, surface, locale and wave.
estimands.does_not_prove: That the framing changed anyone's behaviour, or that it was caused by any publisher's content.

estimands.reason: No campaign, campaign term set, treatment definition, control definition or pre-registration exists. A before/after change without those is not attribution and will not be reported as one.
estimands.does_not_prove: Nothing yet; the estimand is declared so that nobody retro-fits it to an uncontrolled comparison.

target_population.conceptual: GB households (England, Scotland, Wales) with a domestic energy decision matching one of the six evidenced buyer jobs, who might pose that question to a general-purpose AI assistant or answer engine.
target_population.measured: Non-probability set of 46 canonical intent cells derived from public evidence, run on selected surfaces. It is a purposive instrument, not a sample of households or of AI users.
target_population.coverage_limitation: No frequency, prevalence or population-weighting evidence exists for any cell. Results describe how these surfaces answer these questions, nothing more.

exclusions: Northern Ireland and non-GB markets (no evidence gathered; regulated-cap evidence is GB-only).
Business, SME and employer salary-sacrifice buyers (website-only standing; no buyer evidence).
Prepayment, arrears, Warm Home Discount and other affordability-support contexts (unresearched in this run).
Renters, flats and park homes for the heating job (unresearched).
Non-English locales including cy-GB (no evidence, no native reviewer).
Any prompt derived from an observed AI answer, a target page, or a desired landing page.
products: standard variable and fixed domestic supply
wholesale-linked daily and half-hourly import tariffs
heat pump supply and installation plus heating tariff
smart metering as an enabling product

time_horizon.decay_rules: B5 cells expire on their review-by date; the price-cap cell must be re-read by 2026-08-26 when the next cap period is published.

surfaces.description: Frontier closed model via API, no tools
Second frontier closed model via API, no tools
Retrieval-first answer engine with exposed citations
General assistant with web search enabled and citations exposed
Consumer assistant app, clean account archetype, GB locale, no personalisation history
Search-engine AI answer module, GB locale, clean session

run_budget.estimated_observations_per_wave: 72 candidates across 6 surfaces at 3 repeats is on the order of 1,300 observations per full wave; sentinel deepening adds roughly 180. A cheaper first wave can run 2 surfaces (one per active lane pair) for about 430 observations.

review_budget.assumed: Human review of the QA ledger and of every disputed core, aided-exception and locale decision, roughly 2-3 hours at Gate 3 and 1-2 hours at Gate 4 per version.

precision_notes: No variance pilot has been run, so no minimum detectable difference can be stated. Percentages must not be published for any subgroup with fewer than 20-30 distinct cells; report counts and answers instead.

jobs, language, roles, locales, strategic priority
